name: Kimi Code Provider (ACP)
description: Adds Kimi Code as a session provider, driven over the Agent Client Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio) via `kimi acp` — a persistent process for the whole session, with streaming text/thinking, tool calls and live permission prompts. Requires the kimi CLI installed and authenticated on this machine (an API key, or `kimi acp --login`). Known limitation: Kimi maps a failed turn to the same stopReason as a successful one, so this provider cannot tell the two apart from the wire alone.
author: Cockpit
